threat_event: Attacker takes over the owner's business mailbox (adversary-in-the-middle phishing captures the password and text-message code) and sends a client false remittance instructions for a pay app
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Text-message codes do not resist phishing; no sign-in or forwarding-rule review; no DMARC; clients never told how remittance changes work; no cyber or social engineering insurance
existing_controls: Text-message 2-step verification; email provider's spam filtering
treatment_plan: Security key on email and remove text codes; monthly and pre-pay-app check of sign-ins and forwarding rules; DKIM and DMARC; written remittance-change notice in every contract and on every pay app cover sheet; get a quote for cyber insurance with social engineering coverage (P08)

threat_event: Spoofed or compromised subcontractor email asks the owner to change the subcontractor's bank account before a payment, and the owner pays the attacker
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Bank changes accepted by email with no call-back; one person requests, enters, and approves payments; near miss in March 2026
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-02 vendor records; SYS-07 bank; BP-02 subcontractor payments
existing_controls: Bank app approval for new payees; $30,000 daily ACH limit
treatment_plan: Call-back to the number in the signed subcontract before any bank change; 5-business-day wait and a $1 test deposit confirmed by phone before paying a changed account; accounting SaaS alert on any vendor bank-detail change (POL-01 7.6)

threat_event: Attacker takes over the owner's SAM account and changes the EFT information so the VA payment for FC-1 goes to a mule account
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Owner is the only Entity Administrator; no check of SAM banking details against the bank; password reused elsewhere before 2026
treatment_plan: Unique passphrase in the password manager; security key on the government sign-in account; check SAM EFT details against the bank before each FC-1 invoice

threat_event: The outside bookkeeper's device or the shared accounting password is compromised, and an attacker changes vendor bank details or exports W-9 forms
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Bookkeeper uses the owner's credentials; password only; no change alerts; bookkeeper's security unknown
treatment_plan: Separate accountant-role account for the bookkeeper; MFA on both accounts; change the owner's password; confidentiality and 10-day breach notice terms added to the engagement letter

threat_event: A family member installs malicious software or opens a phishing link on the shared laptop login, exposing FCI, saved passwords, and the bank session
threat_source: Family member error leading to malware
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One administrator login shared with family; saved browser passwords
treatment_plan: Separate standard account for family; owner works from a standard account; passwords move to the password manager

threat_event: Attacker uses the router's default administrator password and remote administration to change its settings and redirect the owner's traffic to look-alike sign-in pages
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Default administrator password and remote administration on (found in P07 on 2026-07-21 and fixed that day); firmware from 2021; family and smart-home devices on the same network
existing_controls: Host firewall on the laptop; SaaS traffic uses TLS
treatment_plan: Password changed and remote administration off (2026-07-21); update or replace the router; separate work network with family and smart-home devices on the guest network; quarterly firmware check

threat_event: Use of covered telecommunications equipment (the mobile hotspot) and an unsupported SAM representation lead to contract remedies or loss of federal eligibility
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No Section 889 inquiry before purchases or before the January 2026 SAM renewal; carrier-branded label hid the manufacturer
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-06 hotspot; SAM representations; FC-1 and the DoD subcontract
treatment_plan: Return the device; manufacturer check before buying any network, phone, or camera equipment; documented reasonable inquiry before each SAM renewal; ask a government contracting assistance counselor or counsel whether the January 2026 representation needs correcting

threat_event: The owner cannot achieve Final Level 1 (Self) and affirm in SPRS before the DoD subcontract is awarded, and the prime gives the work to another subcontractor
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No self-assessment, no SPRS access, and 13 of the 17 FAR requirement rows not fully met (P03)
affected_asset_or_process: DoD subcontract (about 25% of next year's receipts); BP-04
treatment_plan: Close every FAR 52.204-21 gap; self-assess against the NIST SP 800-171A objectives; SPRS access; affirmation by the owner (P03 roadmap)

threat_event: FCI stored outside the boundary is exposed or used to train a vendor's model (AI bid assistant uploads, personal photo cloud, free file-transfer links)
threat_source: Service providers the owner does not control
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No approved-systems list; AI tool allowed model improvement until 2026-07-17; work photos sync to a personal account
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-09 AI tool; SYS-05 phone; FC-1 drawings
treatment_plan: Approved locations for FCI in POL-01 8.2; no FCI in the AI tool unless business terms bar training (P10); photo sync off for work; subcontractors upload to SYS-01 only

threat_event: The owner is suddenly unavailable (jobsite injury or illness) or loses the only phone, so nobody can supervise jobsites, pay subcontractors, or reach the bank and federal portals
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One person holds every role and credential; every second factor on one phone; no standby agreement
regulatory_driver: Business need (P05); FAR 52.232-27(c) prompt payment on FC-1
treatment_plan: Standby supervision agreement with another small general contractor; sealed recovery codes and emergency access sheet with the owner's attorney; security key as a second sign-in method; ask the bank about a limited authorized signer (P05)

threat_event: The phone is lost or stolen at a jobsite, locking the owner out and exposing email, photos, and the bank app
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Phone holds every second factor; no recovery codes stored; remote wipe not tested
treatment_plan: Store recovery codes (sealed envelope); turn on and test find-and-wipe; security key as a backup factor

threat_event: Laptop failure, theft, or ransomware loses estimates, scanned lien waivers, and W-9 forms that exist only on the laptop
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No backup of laptop files; no export of SYS-01 records
regulatory_driver: Business need (P05 BP-04); FAR 52.222-8(a) records retention
existing_controls: Disk encryption limits disclosure, not loss
treatment_plan: File sync with version history for the laptop work folder; quarterly SYS-01 export kept in the business file storage

threat_event: A subcontractor that received FC-1 drawings without the FAR 52.204-21 flowdown has a breach or posts drawings publicly
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Subcontracts incorporate federal clauses by reference only; portal default role exposes the whole project folder
affected_asset_or_process: FC-1 drawings in SYS-01; subcontractors' systems
treatment_plan: Federal subcontract rider with the substance of 52.204-21 and 52.204-25; trade-only portal permissions; reissue to the 6 FC-1 subcontractors

threat_event: A business email compromise or other incident is not recognized in time, so the bank recall window, the one-business-day Section 889 report, or a Florida notice deadline is missed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No incident plan, contact list, or training before 2026-08-31
treatment_plan: Adopt the P08 runbook; printed contact card in the truck and home office; payment fraud training for the owner

threat_event: A hurricane damages the home office or storage unit and shuts jobsites for several days
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single home office; paper files and tools on site
existing_controls: All records except laptop files are in SaaS and reachable from the phone
treatment_plan: Accepted: residual risk Low. Take the laptop and paper contract files when a storm watch is issued; laptop backup (R-012) removes the remaining data loss
